k-01.title: Refuse without saying no directly
k-01.goal: Use short chat to work out say person dey gently refuse one day, not di whole plan. Point to di evidence, then write your own gentle refusal and suggest another option.
k-01.material:
Two classmates, 민수 and 수진, dey send messages. Dem dey use polite -요 speech with each other. (😅 = face with small sweat drop and awkward smile.)

민수: 토요일에 영화 볼까요?
수진: 토요일은 좀… 😅
민수: 그럼 일요일은요?
수진: 일요일은 좋아요!
k-01.thinking.0: Work out refusal wey person no talk directly
k-01.thinking.1: Separate wetin person refuse (di day) from wetin person no refuse (di plan)
k-01.prereq.1: You know basic -아요/어요 endings and words for days of di week
k-01.s.s1.hint.0: Read di next line from 민수: how 민수 take respond?
k-01.s.s1.hint.1: Notice say 수진 no talk 네 or 아니요. Wetin 수진 leave unfinished?
k-01.s.s1.o.a: Saturday no good for 수진; na that day 수진 dey refuse.
k-01.s.s1.o.b: Saturday good well well for 수진, and 수진 dey excited.
k-01.s.s1.r.b: '좀…' wey no finish, together with awkward emoji, dey show hesitation, not excitement. Check di response for di next line (그럼 일요일은요?).
k-01.s.s1.o.c: 수진 no ever wan watch film with 민수.
k-01.s.s1.r.c: This interpretation go too far. Di last line, 일요일은 좋아요!, show say 수진 still wan go.
k-01.s.s1.r.d: 수진 answer di question directly by naming di day, so 수진 understand am.
k-01.s.s1.explain: '좀…' dey soften refusal so nobody need talk '안 돼요' directly. Di topic marker -은 for '토요일은' dey single out Saturday; 민수 respond by suggesting another day.
k-01.s.s2.prompt: Which evidence show say 수진 still wan watch di film? Choose all wey apply.
k-01.s.s2.hint.0: Find di lines where 수진 talk something positive.
k-01.s.s2.hint.1: Compare wetin 수진 name for '토요일은 좀…' with wetin 수진 name for '일요일은 좋아요!'.
k-01.s.s2.o.a: 수진 answer '일요일은 좋아요!' when 민수 suggest Sunday.
k-01.s.s2.r.b: '좀' dey soften refusal; e no tell you whether 수진 like di plan.
k-01.s.s2.r.c: Di emoji show awkward feeling; e no prove say 수진 wan watch di film.
k-01.s.s2.o.d: 수진 talk '토요일은', naming only di day, not di film itself.
k-01.s.s2.explain: 수진 no reject di film. Na only Saturday (토요일은) 수진 reject, and 수진 accept Sunday.
k-01.s.s2.acc.0: E reasonable to give only di clearest evidence (수진 accept Sunday); d also point out say na only di day 수진 name, not di film.
k-01.s.s3.prompt: Your classmate 민수 invite you to eat out for Saturday, but you no fit go. Reply for Korean with 요-speech: no talk '싫어요', refuse gently and suggest another day.
k-01.s.s3.hint.0: First talk sorry or say e be pity, then mention Saturday.
k-01.s.s3.hint.1: Talk sorry or give short reason, then finish with question wey suggest another day.
k-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: My reply make am clear say Saturday no fit work for me?
k-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: I keep di friendship warm with gentle expression and another option?
k-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: 민수 go know wetin to do next?
k-01.s.s3.model.0: 죄송해요, 토요일은 좀 어려워요. 일요일은 어때요?
k-01.s.s3.modelNote.0: Short and gentle; e use 좀 and suggest another day.
k-01.s.s3.model.1: 아, 토요일은 일이 있어서 어려울 것 같아요. 그럼 일요일에 만나요!
k-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: E give reason instead of 좀, then suggest Sunday.
k-01.s.s3.humanReview: Person need check whether di tone warm and natural, and whether di reason believable and no rude.
k-01.s.s3.check.w1.label: E end with polite 요/습니다
k-01.s.s3.check.w2.label: E name another day/time apart from Saturday (일요일, 내일, 다음 ...)
k-01.s.s3.check.w3.label: gentle expression or reason (좀, 죄송, 약속, 일이 있 ...)
k-01.s.s3.check.w4.label: E no just talk '싫어'
k-01.s.s3.check.w5.label: E really make suggestion (어때요, -ㄹ까요, 에 만나요 ...)
